docs.title: Packages
docs.text: Package Description jarvis-embed Embed the Jarvis AI Assistant in any web application

docs.title: Jarvis Embed SDK
docs.text: Embed the Jarvis AI Assistant in any web application. Works with bundlers and script tags.

docs.title: Browser (no bundler)
docs.text:
<script src="https://ascending-llc.github.io/jarvis-embed/latest/jarvis-embed.js"></script>
<script>
  const { JarvisEmbed } = window.JarvisSDK;
  const jarvis = new JarvisEmbed({ provider: 'google', token: googleIdToken, containerId: 'chat-container' });
</script>
